output.methodChoice: Combination of C and D: Kepner-Tregoe IS/IS NOT comparison across sites, plus competing-hypothesis testing, because the site-level natural contrasts discriminate between the hypotheses.
output.brief: Volunteers did not leave because of the app alone, the background checks, or a rival group. They left where two changes overlapped. Dock Street and Westgate have the app and lost their coordinators on 1 May. The app's basic tier doesn't keep recurring weekly slots, so someone has to book regulars in before each Thursday release. Coordinators used to do that. Manual bookings fell from 74 a week to 3, and an admin seat sits unused. Of the 213 April regulars at those two sites, 129 lost their usual slot at least twice in May–June, and 114 of those have since gone inactive. Only 9 of the 84 who kept their slot are inactive. Millbrook has the app but kept its coordinator, and Quarry Lane lost its coordinator but has no app live and uses a paper roster. Both held steady. Background checks hit all sites equally, and 121 of the 123 who lapsed had current checks. Rival recruitment looks minor, with 2 of the 61 callbacks joining another group. Don't cancel RotaWeave, suspend the checks, or purge the roster. Assign someone to book regulars into their usual slots before each Thursday release at Dock Street and Westgate, and phone lapsed regulars to offer slots back. Review after 60 days. Confidence is fairly high. Be careful at Quarry Lane when the app goes live on 6 Oct.
